subject: S10 renders card faces with <ContentRenderer doc sectionId copy> (public API only)
body: seg10-cards renders flashcard front/back with ContentRenderer from apps/web/src/content/ContentRenderer.tsx: props doc (a TipTap doc of paragraph/text/hardBreak with bold/italic/sub/superscript marks), sectionId (I pass 'card-<id>-front|back'), copy, mode, className. I will not edit your files. If any of those props change in your rework, please post the new shape. Also: noHardcodedCopy.test.ts roots — I'll add 'cards' to the roots list when I integrate (one line); shout if you want to own that edit.
